diagnosis.freshCurrentRelease: Isolated Playwright WebKit desktop and mobile loaded 1,015 CSS rules and remained styled on normal load and reload; the fresh current release did not reproduce the owner report.
diagnosis.reproducedFailure: Chromium and WebKit each cached one immutable 200 text/html SPA fallback for a missing hashed stylesheet, rejected it because of MIME type, and remained unstyled on reload.
diagnosis.reproducedRecovery: With revalidation/no-cache each browser made a second stylesheet request on reload, received text/css, and became styled.
diagnosis.diagnosticEvidence: The ignored .build/safari-css-cache-fixture.mjs produced the immutable failing baseline and revalidated recovery. The committed tests/static-cache-browser.mjs verifies only the supported no-cache second-request and styled-reload behavior.
diagnosis.supportedConclusion: A stale cached SPA fallback is a matching, test-covered failure mechanism; the exact cause and recovery of the owner's Safari session are not proven.
diagnosis.externalDelivery: tailos.tailarr.com changes the package's no-cache asset response to max-age=14400. A missing CSS URL is a 200 text/html SPA fallback with the same four-hour lifetime. A /bundles probe receives the same override, invalidating a path-only workaround.
